Method of Attack: Sending malicious emails that bypass Office 365 security systems by exploiting lack of support for the HTML <base> tag, allowing URLs in emails to evade scanning by Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) and Safelinks
Attack Vector: Malicious emails with rich-text formatting using the <base> HTML tag to obfuscate URLs
Indicators of Compromise: Emails containing <base href> tag with relative URLs that Office 365 security systems fail to properly scan
